payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort chapters in non-decreasing order, then multiply each by current learning power (initial x, decreasing by 1 per subject if >1) and sum to minimize total time.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the chapter counts, then applies a decreasing multiplier x, which is optimal by rearrangement inequality. Sorting is the core step; no custom comparator is used, but among provided subtypes, sorting_custom_key best matches this greedy ordering approach.
